mentions.name: Geocentric
mentions.description: This browser-based multiplayer game lets users collaboratively sculpt a shared planet and place trees or houses. It is planned to evolve into an idle sim where players interact by dropping food and events that drive the creatures on the planet to evolve over time; terrain and user cursors are rendered via shaders.
mentions.source_excerpt: First game is https://geocentric.top where users can sculpt a planet collaboratively and place trees or houses (for now very limited). I plan on making it an idle sim where players will be able to interact by dropping some food/events for the creatures on it to evolve through time.
